datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
SELECT
   A.BOOROWERID AS ID,
   A.NAME AS NAME,
   A.COUNTRYCODE AS COUNTRCODE,
   A.BANKRUPTEYSTATUS AS BNKSTATUS,
   cm_deca.get_custdateofbirth(b.boorowerid) AS DATOFBIRTH, --dogum tarixi
   cm_deca.get_custplaceofbirth(b.boorowerid) AS PLACEBIRTH, --dogum yeri
   A.pincode AS PINCODE,			--pin kod
   A.guarantorid AS GID,	--zamin id
   a.guarantorname AS GNAME,	--zamin ad
   A.guarantorid2 AS GID2,	--zamin id2
   A.guarantorname2 AS GNAME2,	--zamin ad2
   A.guarantorid3 AS GID3,	--zamin id3
   A.guarantorname3 AS GNAME3,	--zamin ad3
   cm_deca.get_credittypes(b.id) CREDITTYPE,	--kreditin tipi
   cm_deca.get_lastcreditpayment(b.id) LASTPAYDAT,	--sonuncu odenish tarixi
   cm_deca.get_creditpaymentamount(b.id) MPAYAMOUNT,	--ayliq odenish
   cm_deca.get_reserveaccountostat(b.id) PROVISION,	--ehtiyyat miqdari
   A.FIRSTOWNERID AS ID2,
   A.FIRSTOWNERNAME AS NAME2,
   A.SECONDOWNERID AS ID3,
   A.SECONDOWNERNAME AS NAME3,
   A.THIRDOWNERID AS ID4,
   A.THIRDOWNERNAME AS NAME4,
   B.ID as InternalID, -- INTERNAL FIELD
   CM_COMMON.AccountNumber_Get(c.LOANACCID) AS ACCOUNTNO ,
   V.VAL_NAME AS CURRENCY,
   cm_deca.get_creditinitialamount(b.id) AS INITIALSUM,
   cm_deca.get_creditlineamount(b.id) AS CRDLINESUM,
   D.REST + D.DUEREST AS DISOUSUM ,
   B.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE AS RATE,
   P.CODE AS PURPOSE,
   TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DATEOFCONCLUSION)) AS PERIODMONT ,
   B.DATEOFCONCLUSION AS DATEGRANT,
   B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT AS FIRSTCONTR,
   DECODE(B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT,null,B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT) AS LASTCONTR,
   CM_DECA.DueDaysCount(:HDATE , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,b.id) AS DAYSMAIN ,
   CM_DECA.DueDaysCount(:HDATE , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,b.id) AS DAYSINTRST ,
   D.DUEINTERESTREST+D.interestrest AS OIAPERIOD ,
   CM_DECA.OiaForLastThreeMonths(:HDATE , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,D.DUEINTERESTREST) AS OIATHREE ,
   0 AS PROLONGS ,
   E.CODE AS CLASSCODE,
   CM_DECA.Get_CreditStatus(B.ID,:HDATE) AS STATUSCODE ,
   DECODE(G.TYPECODE,'000',null,G.TYPECODE) AS COLLCODE,
   F.ANYINFOTODISTING AS INFDISTING,
   D.PLEDGEPRICE  AS MARKETSUM ,
   F.REGISTRYNO AS REGNO,
   F.REGISTRYDATE AS REGDATE,
   F.REGISTRYAGENCY AS REGAGENCY
FROM
   CM_BOOROWERINFO A
 , CM_ACCOUNTS C
 , CM_RESERVE_TYPES E
 , CM_GUARANTEE F
 , CM_PORTFOLIO B
 , CM_PLEDGES G
 , CM_HISTORY D
 , SB_OPERKURS O
 , SB_AVALUTE V
 , CM_CATEGORIES P
WHERE
     (A.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (C.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (D.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (E.ID = D.RESERVEID)
 AND (F.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (G.ID = F.PLEDGEID)
 AND (D.HDATE=:HDATE)
 AND ((B.CLOSEDATE IS NULL) or (B.CLOSEDATE between :EDATE and :HDATE) /*(B.CLOSEDATE >=:HDATE)*/)
 AND (O.DAT=:HDATE)
 AND (O.VAL_KOD=B.CURRENCY)
--AND (O.OSTAT * B.CREDITLINEAMOUNT >= 1000)
 AND (V.VALUTE=B.CURRENCY)
 AND (B.DATEOFCONCLUSION<=:HDATE)
-- AND (B.CLOSEDATE is not null)
 AND (P.ID = B.CUSTOMERTYPE) --and cm_deca.get_creditinitialamount(b.id)>0

   cm_deca.get_credittypes(b.id) CREDITTYPE,    --kreditin tipi

   cm_deca.get_creditpaymentamount(b.id) MPAYAMOUNT,    --ayliq odenish

   A.FIRSTOWNERID AS ID2,

   A.SECONDOWNERID AS ID3,
   A.SECONDOWNERNAME AS NAME3,
   A.THIRDOWNERID AS ID4,

   B.ID as InternalID, -- INTERNAL FIELD
  /* CM_COMMON.AccountNumber_Get(c.LOANACCID)*/b.id AS ACCOUNTNO ,
   V.VAL_NAME AS CURRENCY,
   cm_deca.get_creditinitialamount(b.id) AS INITIALSUM,
   cm_deca.get_creditlineamount(b.id) AS CRDLINESUM,
   D.REST + D.DUEREST AS DISOUSUM ,
   B.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE AS RATE,
   P.CODE AS PURPOSE,
   decode(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DATEOFCONCLUSION)),0,1,TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DATEOFCONCLUSION))) AS PERIODMONT ,
   to_char(B.DATEOFCONCLUSION,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS DATEGRANT,
   to_char(nvl(b.duedatelastcontract,b.duedatefirstcontract),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS FIRSTCONTR,
   to_char( DECODE(B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT,null,B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS LASTCONTR,
   CM_DECA.DueDaysCount(:RDAT , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,b.id) /*d.dueday*/ AS DAYSMAIN ,
   cm_utils.Get_Gecgun_Faiz(b.id,:RDAT) AS DAYSINTRST ,

   CM_DECA.OiaForLastThreeMonths(:RDAT, B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,D.DUEINTERESTREST) AS OIATHREE , 
0 AS PROLONGS ,

 , CM_GUARANTEE F
 , CM_PORTFOLIO B
 , CM_PLEDGES G
 , CM_HISTORY D

 , AVALUTE V
 ,CM_GUARANTOR g1,CM_GUARANTOR g2,CM_GUARANTOR g3
 , CM_CATEGORIES P
WHERE
     (A.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (C.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (D.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (E.ID = D.RESERVEID)
 AND (F.CREDITID(+) = B.ID)
 AND (G.ID(+) = F.PLEDGEID)
 AND (D.HDATE=:RDAT)
 AND ((B.CLOSEDATE IS NULL) or (B.CLOSEDATE between :EDATE and :HDATE) /*(B.CLOSEDATE >=:HDATE)*/)
 AND (O.DAT=:RDAT)
 AND (O.VAL_KOD=B.CURRENCY)
 and b.id=g1.creditid(+) and g1.cardid(+)=1  and b.usrgroup<>2 and b.credittype<>15
 and b.id=g2.creditid(+) and g2.cardid(+)=2
 and b.id=g3.creditid(+) and g3.cardid(+)=3 and b.dateofgrant ıs not null 
 AND (V.VALUTE=B.CURRENCY)  /*and (b.id in(select creditid from cm_tranches)or (b.credittype in(16,17))) */and b.credittype<>15
 AND (B.DATEOFCONCLUSION<=:RDAT) 
 AND (P.ID = B.CUSTOMERTYPE)

   A.pincode AS PINCODE,            --pin kod
   g1.guarantorid AS GID,    --zamin id
   g1.guarantorname AS GNAME,g1.cuntrycode GCUNTRYCODE,to_char(g1.dateofbirth,'dd/mm/yyyy')   GDATEOFBIRTH,g1.cuntry||' '||g1.city GPLACE,nvl(g1.PINCODE,' ') GPINCODE,    --zamin 1
   g2.guarantorid AS GID2,  --zamin 2
   g2.guarantorname AS GNAME2, g2.cuntrycode GCUNTRYCODE2,to_char(g2.dateofbirth,'dd/mm/yyyy') GDATEOFBIRTH2,g2.cuntry||' '||g2.city GPLACE2,nvl(g2.PINCODE,' ') GPINCODE2, --zamin 2
   g3.guarantorid AS GID3,  --zamin id3
   g3.guarantorname AS GNAME3, g3.cuntrycode GCUNTRYCODE3,to_char(g3.dateofbirth,'dd/mm/yyyy') GDATEOFBIRTH3,g3.cuntry||' '||g3.city GPLACE3,nvl(g3.PINCODE,' ') GPINCODE3, --zamin 3,
    g4.guarantorid AS GID4,  --zamin id4
   g4.guarantorname AS GNAME4, g4.cuntrycode GCUNTRYCODE4,to_char(g4.dateofbirth,'dd/mm/yyyy') GDATEOFBIRTH4,g4.cuntry||' '||g4.city GPLACE4,nvl(g4.PINCODE,' ') GPINCODE4, --zamin 4
   cm_deca.get_credittypes(b.id) CREDITTYPE,    --kreditin tipi
   to_char(cm_deca.get_lastcreditpayment(b.id),'dd/mm/yyyy') LASTPAYDAT,    --sonuncu odenish tarixi
   cm_deca.get_creditpaymentamount(b.id) MPAYAMOUNT,    --ayliq odenish
   cm_deca.get_reserveaccountostat(b.id) PROVISION, --ehtiyyat miqdari
   A.FIRSTOWNERID AS ID2,
   A.FIRSTOWNERNAME AS NAME2,
   A.SECONDOWNERID AS ID3,
   A.SECONDOWNERNAME AS NAME3,
   A.THIRDOWNERID AS ID4,
   A.THIRDOWNERNAME AS NAME4,
   B.ID as InternalID, -- INTERNAL FIELD
   B.ID AS ACCOUNTNO ,
   V.VAL_NAME AS CURRENCY,
   cm_deca.get_creditinitialamount(b.id) AS INITIALSUM,
   cm_deca.get_creditlineamount(b.id) AS CRDLINESUM,
   D.REST + D.DUEREST AS DISOUSUM ,
   B.ANNUALYINTERESTRATE AS RATE,
   P.CODE AS PURPOSE,
   decode(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DATEOFCONCLUSION)),0,1,TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DATEOFCONCLUSION))) AS PERIODMONT ,
   to_char(B.dateofgrant/*B.DATEOFCONCLUSION*/,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS DATEGRANT,
   to_char(nvl(b.duedatelastcontract,b.duedatefirstcontract),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS FIRSTCONTR,
   to_char( DECODE(B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT,null,B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,B.DUEDATELASTCONTRACT),'dd/mm/yyyy') AS LASTCONTR,
   CM_DECA.DueDaysCount(:RDAT , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,b.id) /*d.dueday*/ AS DAYSMAIN ,
   cm_utils.Get_GecgunFaiz(b.id,:RDAT)/*d.dueday*/ AS DAYSINTRST,
   D.DUEINTERESTREST+D.interestrest AS OIAPERIOD ,
   CM_DECA.OiaForLastThreeMonths(:RDAT, B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,D.DUEINTERESTREST) AS OIATHREE , 
0 AS PROLONGS ,
  case when  CM_DECA.DueDaysCount(:RDAT , B.DUEDATEFIRSTCONTRACT,b.id)<361 then E.CODE else '006' end AS CLASSCODE,
   CM_DECA.Get_CreditStatus(B.ID,:RDAT )AS STATUSCODE ,
   DECODE(G.TYPECODE,'000',null,G.TYPECODE) AS COLLCODE,
   F.ANYINFOTODISTING AS INFDISTING,
   F.PLEDGEPRICE  AS MARKETSUM ,
   F.REGISTRYNO AS REGNO,
  to_char( F.REGISTRYDATE,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS REGDATE,
   F.REGISTRYAGENCY AS REGAGENCY
FROM
   CM_BOOROWERINFO A
 , CM_ACCOUNTS C
 , CM_RESERVE_TYPES E
 , /*CM_GUARANTEE*/ cm_grov_list F
 , CM_PORTFOLIO B
 , CM_PLEDGES G
 , CM_HISTORY D
 , OPERKURS O
 , AVALUTE V
 ,CM_GUARANTOR g1,CM_GUARANTOR g2,CM_GUARANTOR g3,CM_GUARANTOR g4
 , CM_CATEGORIES P
WHERE
     (A.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (C.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (D.CREDITID = B.ID)
 AND (E.ID = D.RESERVEID)
 AND (F.CREDITID(+) = B.ID)
 AND (G.ID(+) = F.PLEDGEID)
 AND (D.HDATE=:RDAT)
 AND ((B.CLOSEDATE IS NULL) or (B.CLOSEDATE between :EDATE and :HDATE) /*(B.CLOSEDATE >=:HDATE)*/)
 AND (O.DAT=:RDAT)
 AND (O.VAL_KOD=B.CURRENCY)
 and b.id=g1.creditid(+) and g1.cardid(+)=1
 and b.id=g2.creditid(+) and g2.cardid(+)=2   --and b.id>357
 and b.id=g3.creditid(+) and g3.cardid(+)=3 --and b.dateofgrant ıs not null 
 and b.id=g4.creditid(+) and g4.cardid(+)=4
 AND (V.VALUTE=B.CURRENCY) --and b.status=1 --and b.mehsulid<>5 and (b.id in(select creditid from cm_tranches)or (b.credittype in(16,17))) and b.credittype<>15
 AND (/*B.DATEOFCONCLUSION*/B.dateofgrant<=:RDAT) --and b.boorowerid not in(50,51,139,101,2841,41200)
 AND (P.ID = B.CUSTOMERTYPE) --and INSTR(b.numberofcredit,'SPC')=0--and cm_deca.get_creditinitialamount(b.id)>0

datasets.sql:
/* Formatted on 25.12.2023 12:43:05 (QP5 v5.336) */
SELECT    replace(XMLELEMENT (
                   "Credit",
                   XMLELEMENT (
                       "Borrower",
                       XMLFOREST (
                           b.boorowerid AS "id",
                           DECODE (b.name, '&', '_', b.name) AS "name",
                           b.countrycode AS "CountryCode",
                           b.bankrupteystatus AS "BankruptcyStatus",
                           TO_CHAR (
                               cm_deca.get_custdateofbirth (p.boorowerid),
                               'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "DateOfBirth",  --dogum tarixi
                           cm_deca.get_custplaceofbirth (p.boorowerid)
                               AS "PlaceOfBirth",                 --dogum yeri
                           b.pincode AS "PinCode"),
                       (SELECT XMLELEMENT (
                                   "Guarantees",
                                   XMLAGG (
                                       XMLELEMENT (
                                           "Guarantee",
                                           XMLFOREST (
                                               e.guarantorid AS "id",
                                               e.guarantorname AS "name",
                                               e.cuntrycode "CountryCode",
                                               TO_CHAR (e.dateofbirth,
                                                        'dd/mm/yyyy')
                                                   "DateOfBirth",
                                               e.cuntry || ' ' || e.city
                                                   "PlaceOfBirth",
                                               NVL (e.pincode, ' ') "PinCode")))) AS zamin
                        FROM cm_guarantor e
                        WHERE e.creditid = p.id)),
                   XMLFOREST (
                       /* case when p.dateofconclusion<'03-mar-2023' then p.numberofcredit else  to_char(p.id) end AS*/to_char(p.id) "AccountNo",
                       v.val_name AS "CurrencyOfCredit",
                       cm_deca.get_credittypes (p.id) AS "CreditType",
                       cm_deca.get_creditinitialamount (p.id)
                           AS "InitialAmountOfCredit",
                       cm_deca.get_creditlineamount (p.id)
                           AS "CreditLineAmount",
                       d.rest + d.duerest AS "DisoutAmountOfCredit",
                       p.annualyinterestrate AS "AnnualInterestRate",
                       c.code AS "PurposeOfCredit",
                       DECODE (
                           CEIL(
                               MONTHS_BETWEEN (p.duedatefirstcontract,
                                               p.dateofconclusion)),
                           0, 1,
                           CEIL(
                               MONTHS_BETWEEN (p.duedatefirstcontract,
                                               p.dateofconclusion)))
                           AS "CreditPeriodInMonths",
                       TO_CHAR (p.dateofgrant, 'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "DateOfGrant",
                       TO_CHAR (
                           NVL (p.duedatelastcontract,
                                p.duedatefirstcontract),
                           'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "DueTimeFirstContract",
                       TO_CHAR (
                           DECODE (p.duedatelastcontract,
                                   NULL, p.duedatefirstcontract,
                                   p.duedatelastcontract),
                           'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "DueTimeLastContract",
                      nvl( TO_CHAR (cm_deca.get_lastcreditpayment (p.id),
                                'dd/mm/yyyy'),'@') AS "LastPaymentDate",
                       cm_deca.get_creditpaymentamount (p.id)
                           AS "MonthlyPaymentAmount",
                       cm_deca.duedayscount (d.hdate,
                                             p.duedatefirstcontract,
                                             p.id) AS "DaysMainSumIsOverdue",
                       cm_utils.get_gecgunfaiz (p.id, d.hdate)
                           AS "DaysInterestIsOverdue",
                       d.dueinterestrest + d.interestrest
                           AS "OiaForRepperiod",
                       0 AS "NumberOfProlongs",
                       CASE
                           WHEN cm_deca.duedayscount (d.hdate,
                                                      p.duedatefirstcontract,
                                                      p.id) <
                                361
                           THEN
                               e.code
                           ELSE
                               '006'
                       END AS "CreditClassCode",
                       cm_deca.get_creditstatus (p.id, d.hdate)
                           AS "CreditStatusCode"),
                   (SELECT XMLELEMENT (
                               "Collateral",
                                XMLELEMENT("CollateralTypeCode",gr.typecode),
                                XMLELEMENT("AnyInfoToDisting",gr.anyinfotodisting),
                                XMLELEMENT("MarketValue",gr.pledgeprice),
                                XMLELEMENT("RegistryNo",gr.registryno),
                                XMLELEMENT("RegistryDate",gr.registrydate),
                                XMLELEMENT("RegistryAgency",gr.registryagency))
                    FROM (SELECT '004' AS typecode,
                                 '' AS anyinfotodisting,
                                 '' AS registryno,
                                 0   AS pledgeprice,
                                 '' AS registrydate,
                                 '' AS pledgeid,
                                 '' AS registryagency
                          FROM cm_guarantor z
                          WHERE     z.creditid = p.id                                
                                AND z.creditid NOT IN
                                        (SELECT x.creditid
                                         FROM cm_guarantee_credit x
                                         WHERE x.creditid = z.creditid)
                                         AND ROWNUM = 1
                                         
                          UNION ALL
                          SELECT typecode,
                                 anyinfotodisting,
                                 registryno,
                                 pledgeprice,
                                 TO_CHAR (f.registrydate, 'dd/mm/yyyy')
                                     registrydate,
                                 TO_CHAR (pledgeid)
                                     pledgeid,
                                 registryagency
                          FROM cm_guarantee f, cm_pledges g
                          WHERE f.creditid = p.id AND g.id(+) = f.pledgeid)
                         gr) AS grov).getClobVal() ,'@','') AS credit
FROM cm_portfolio p,
     cm_boorowerinfo b,
     avalute v,
     cm_history d,
     cm_categories c,
     cm_reserve_types e
WHERE     p.id = b.creditid
      AND p.currency = v.valute
      AND p.id = d.creditid
  AND (D.HDATE=:RDAT)
 AND ((p.CLOSEDATE IS NULL) or (p.CLOSEDATE between :EDATE and :HDATE) )
      AND c.id = p.customertype
      AND (e.id = d.reserveid)
and p.dateofgrant<=:RDAT
